repo_notes.content: The documentation should teach users how to make games before teaching engine implementation details. Every chapter should build upon the previous one.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduction to Kinemium, what it is, why it exists, how it differs from Roblox, Unity, and Godot, and what you will build throughout this tutorial.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installing Kinemium, creating a project, understanding the workspace, and running your first game.

pages.title: Installation
pages.purpose: Installing Zune, Kinemium, native dependencies, and required tooling.

pages.title: Creating a Project
pages.purpose: Creating a project, understanding kproj.toml, and opening the editor.

pages.title: Project Layout
pages.purpose: Understanding folders, assets, scripts, packages, and configuration files.

pages.title: Running Your Game
pages.purpose: Running client, server, editor, and headless modes.

pages.title: Learning Kilang
pages.purpose: A beginner-friendly introduction to scripting in Kinemium using Kilang.

pages.title: Variables and Types
pages.purpose: Numbers, strings, booleans, tables, and type annotations.

pages.title: Functions
pages.purpose: Creating reusable code and understanding scope.

pages.title: Control Flow
pages.purpose: if statements, loops, pattern matching, and iteration.

pages.title: Modules
pages.purpose: Creating reusable modules and importing them.

pages.title: Your First Game
pages.purpose: Build a simple game while learning the engine.

pages.title: Creating Parts
pages.purpose: Creating objects, setting properties, parenting, and destroying instances.

pages.title: Moving Objects
pages.purpose: Using CFrame, Vector3, and movement.

pages.title: Events
pages.purpose: Signals, input, and connecting callbacks.

pages.title: Services
pages.purpose: Workspace, Players, Lighting, RunService, and accessing engine services.

pages.title: Building Gameplay
pages.purpose: Combining everything into a playable experience.

pages.title: Engine API
pages.purpose: Reference documentation for all scripting APIs.

pages.title: Instances
pages.purpose: All engine classes and inheritance.

pages.title: Datatypes
pages.purpose: Vector3, CFrame, Color3, UDim2, Rect, and other engine datatypes.

pages.title: Enums
pages.purpose: Complete enumeration reference.

pages.title: Modules and Packages
pages.purpose: Aliases, package imports, and module resolution.

pages.title: Advanced Scripting
pages.purpose: Writing larger and more efficient games.

pages.title: Networking
pages.purpose: Client/server architecture, replication, and remote communication.

pages.title: Physics
pages.purpose: Rigid bodies, constraints, forces, and collision.

pages.title: Rendering
pages.purpose: Lighting, models, materials, animations, and rendering APIs.

pages.title: GUI
pages.purpose: Creating user interfaces using Aereon.

pages.title: Engine Internals
pages.purpose: For advanced users interested in contributing to or extending Kinemium itself.

pages.title: Instance System
pages.purpose: How objects are created, stored, and managed internally.

pages.title: Physics Architecture
pages.purpose: Jolt integration, Impulse3D, synchronization, and backend abstraction.
